newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post business - Jan 17.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post business - Jan 17.

text.p: The Washington Post carried the following items on the front page of its business section on January 17:
WASHINGTON - With inflation and unemployment trends stable, Federal Reserve officials appear unlikely to raise short-term interest rates anytime soon.

WASHINGTON - This week, the Supreme Court without comment refused to hear arguments that the District-based Madison National Bank and its sister bank in Virginia were not given proper notice before being shut down by the Office of the Comptroller of the Currency.

NEW YORK - Smith Barney, the brokerage firm that is fighting lawsuits filed by 25 women alleging it tolerated widespread sexual harrassment and discrimination, is considering ways to block employee access to sex and hate speech sites on the Internet.
WASHINGTON - General Motors Corp announced it will sell its Hughes Aircraft Co division to Raytheon Co for $9.5 billion.
